Organized Chaos

  • MediumPaint marker & Vantablack paint

  • CategoryMixed-media
  • Notes17" x 24" on drawing paper

Overview

Another assignment project for my Suffolk art class was for us to create something with a process. In this piece, I wanted to capture the feeling of organized chaos by containing random splashes of vantablack paint inside differently-arranged colored boxes, all surrounded by mysterious blue markings, every single one of which is a different shape.

Process / Additional Notes

Started by layering painter's tape in various orientations across a drawing pad, and assembling the piece layer-by-layer, finishing with the blue markings. No two blue markings are the same.
